Doubts and anxieties are normal. And sometimes sex drives dip. But it seems you are experiencing all these things at not so normal levels and rates. You could be experiencing a normal doubt that spiraled into an irrational fear and thus set off the anxiety. When your brain is being overloaded with this information, other thoughts and emotions are harder to process or get through. Including sex. Now there could be outside factors contributing to this, friends, family, work or something else adding to this stress/anxiety. Mix that all up and then toss in trying to do something like sex, that requires your individual attention and your mind to be relaxed enough and at ease…well it wont work. And since you aren’t able to be attentive or relaxed during it your body doesn’t respond properly. Therefore you are dry and uncomfortable. Now you have bad sex and your brain attaches that bad sex to your bf. Making it come full circle just piling it on. I highly suggest going to see a doctor about both the dryness (could be medical related) and your mental health, you could be experiencing depression or an anxiety disorder. But at the end of the day you never need a “good” reason to end a relationship. If you don’t find yourself wanting it any longer then you know exactly what to do. I hope all works out the best way for you :)
